title: 第108章 旧冰谷前的死人火第107章 三宗乱阵下
slug: 天赋每周一刷新从变废为宝开始成仙
content_zh:
右侧冰壁下，有一排火堆。
七个木牌，七个名字。
其中三个是玄阳宗弟子，两个赤霞宗弟子，一个散修，还有一个名字让顾清寒眼神微微一动。
“鹤咏仙门，韩无极。”
周荒挑眉。
“韩无极？”
这个名字，他当然记得。
外门小比时，外门第一韩无极。
他曾服血灵丹，败在自己手里。
后来黑炉线不断牵出，韩无极这个人虽然受审，却没有像魏世成那样彻底废掉。
没想到，他竟然也来了北冥。
还被烧名。
顾清寒道：
“韩无极之前被判戴罪入北冥外围巡查。”
“看来出事了。”
周荒看着那堆小火。
韩无极三个字正在一点点变黑。
火很小。
却烧得极稳。
周荒没有嘲笑。

人都快被炼了，旧怨可以先放一边。
“救不救？”
沈青禾问。
周荒道：
“能救就救。”
顾清寒看了他一眼。
周荒笑了笑。
“别这么看我。”
“他以前想踩我，但罪不至于被血炉炼成材料。”
“再说，活人是证人。”
顾清寒点头。
“这句话顺耳。”
周荒走向右侧火堆。
可刚靠近十丈，七堆火同时一亮。
火苗里浮出七张脸。
每一张脸都闭着眼。
像沉在火里睡觉。
玄阳宗弟子看到其中一张脸，立刻喊道：
“林师弟！”
那火中人脸微微一动。

嘴唇开合。
content_en:
Under the ice wall on the right side, there is a row of fires.
Seven wooden signs, seven names.
Three of them were Xuanyang Sect disciples, two Chixia Sect disciples, one was a casual cultivator, and there was another name that made Gu Qinghan's eyes move slightly.
"He Yong Xianmen, Han Wuji."
Zhou Huang raised his eyebrows.
"Han Wuji?"
Of course he remembered this name.
During the outer sect competition, Han Wuji ranked first in the outer sect.
He once took the Blood Spirit Pill and was defeated by his own hands.
Later, the black furnace wires were continuously drawn out. Although Han Wuji was put on trial, he was not completely destroyed like Wei Shicheng.
Unexpectedly, he also came to Beiming.
His name was also burned.
Gu Qinghan said:
"Han Wuji was previously sentenced to patrol the periphery of Beiming."
"It seems something happened."
Zhou Huang looked at the small fire.
The three characters "Han Wuji" are gradually getting darker.
The fire is small.
But it burned very steadily.
Zhou Huang did not laugh.
People are about to be refined, so old grudges can be put aside for now.
"Save or not?"
Shen Qinghe asked.
Zhou Huang said:
"Save it if you can."
Gu Qinghan glanced at him.
Zhou Huang smiled.
"Don't look at me like that."
"He wanted to step on me before, but his sin is not something that can be refined into materials in a blood furnace."
"Besides, living people are witnesses."
Gu Qinghan nodded.
"This sentence is pleasant to the ears."
Zhou Huang walked towards the fire on the right.
But as soon as it got close to ten feet, seven piles of fire lit up at the same time.
Seven faces emerged from the flames.
Every face has eyes closed.
Like sleeping in a fire.
When Xuanyang Sect disciples saw one of the faces, they immediately shouted:
"Junior brother Lin!"
The face of the man in the fire moved slightly.
Lips open and close.
